change: The dedicated evaluation runner rejects any persisted LangGraph checkpoint before graph invocation, including a checkpoint with no messages but pending state.
basis: The installed LangGraph getState implementation returns createdAt only when it loaded a saved checkpoint; a new thread returns values {}, next [], tasks [] without createdAt.
limits: The checkpoint test uses a scripted graph and settlement dependency; it does not prove PostgreSQL recovery or a real provider call.
A checkpoint that exists requires manual reconciliation. Automatic replay and task retry remain disabled for this case.
Independent Gold, G15 paid admission and real dual-arm reviewer verdicts remain open; G17-G20 remain paused.
